description: Main application component for a React-based frontend, setting up routing, navigation, and protected routes. Defines the app layout with navigation sidebar, header, and route components.

classes.name: Shell
classes.description: A layout component providing top navigation bar, sidebar navigation, and main content area.

classes.description: A component that protects routes by checking for an active user session and redirects to the auth page if not authenticated.

classes.name: AppRouter
classes.description: Sets up route configurations including public and protected routes, nested within the app shell.

methods.description: React component for the main application shell, including navigation and content display.
